en: Sepia-tone postcard showing a panoramic view of a European city area dominated by a large neo‑Gothic church with twin spires on a low hill. The church is surrounded by wooden fences, smaller wooden and stone houses, and some distant urban structures such as a water tower. Decorative corner elements frame the image. Printed caption text appears at the top left and along the bottom edge.
